# Copper Tube - 22mm x 3m

The 22 mm x 3 m Copper tube is a high-quality and durable piping solution designed to meet rigorous industry standards. This copper tube is meticulously manufactured to adhere to the specifications outlined in British Standard 2871, specifically Part 1, Table X, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

The copper tube boasts BS EN 1057/+A1 half-hard characteristics, striking a balance between flexibility and strength. This particular type of copper tubing is Kitemarked, signifying that it has undergone thorough testing and complies with established quality and safety standards.

The copper tube is conveniently supplied in lengths of 3 metres, with a wall thickness of 0.9 mm, providing versatility in various plumbing and HVAC applications. Whether used for residential or commercial projects, the 22 mm Copper tube offers excellent corrosion resistance, making it suitable for diverse environments.

Due to its compliance with industry standards and Kitemark certification it provide reassurance for applications where reliability is paramount.

CompatiblePipe Fittings,Pipe Tools&Pipe Insulationavailable

Benefits

*   Meets British standards 2871
*   Half hard characteristics
*   Undergone Kitemark quality testing
*   Comes in lengths of 3 metres
*   High quality copper material
*   Wall thickness of 0.9 mm

### Frequently Asked Questions

How much is delivery?+

Orders over £50 (excluding VAT) qualify for free delivery within the UK.

Orders under £50 (excluding VAT) will incur a delivery charge of £4.95 plus VAT.

Orders to an EU country will incur a delivery charge of £4.95 plus VAT.

* * *

I need my order urgently, do you offer a next day service?+

We offer a next day delivery service available for mainland UK if ordered by 9pm Monday – Friday, and 3pm Sunday for delivery Monday.

For countries outside of the UK please refer to the table above.

* * *

Can I track my delivery?+

You will receive a tracking number and courier information as soon as your item has been dispatched, which will be sent to the email and telephone number provided.

* * *

How long will delivery take?+

Our typical delivery times, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays can be found in the table above.

While we strive to meet delivery estimates, delays may occur due to various factors, such as product availability. We cannot be held liable for delays beyond our control.

If we cannot meet this timeframe, we'll notify you. You'll then have the option to cancel the order, and we'll refund you within 30 days.

* * *

Do you ship outside of the UK?+

For delivery times to countries outside the UK and EU, please contact us.

We regret that there may be countries outside the UK to which we will not deliver Goods.

* * *

What will happen on the day of delivery?+

Once your order leaves us, the courier will contact you directly with tracking details and options to reschedule your delivery.

The courier may confirm delivery by taking a signature, recording it on a handheld device, photographing the parcel, or using GPS co-ordinates.

Please note: Our drivers aren’t responsible for unloading the goods unless this has been agreed in advance

* * *

Can I make alternative delivery arrangements?+

Please contact us prior to placing your order to make us aware of this.

* * *

I'm missing items from my order, what should I do?+

If anything is missing from your delivery, please let us know in writing within three working days of receiving your order.

If your entire order hasn’t arrived at all, please contact us within seven days of the date we told you it was dispatched.
